Intraoperative frozen pathology has certain reference value, but the misdiagnosis rate remains high. For single cancer, we should perform tumor resection together with ipsilateral thyroid lobe resection, lymph node dissection, including thymic tongue and lymph nodes around the trachea. At the same time we should explore other parathyroid gland. We should not only attach importance to treat the primary disease, but also attach great importance to the complications. Postoperative monitoring of PTH and blood calcium concentration is necesary. If Postoperative PTH and blood calcium concentration remain high it suggest tumors have not been completely removed or exist other lesions, even exist distant metastasis and it has poor prognosis.

articleTitle: Face Alignment Based on Incremental Learning for Bayonet Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper proposed an improved Local Binary Features (LBF) [1] algorithm for bayonet surveillance system. Since LBF is based on shape-regression strategy, which is prone to over-fitting after multi-stage regression, the training model cannot be directly applied to other scenarios. To this end, we employed new data into existing models at the final stage of regression. As a consequent, newly imported data can be embedded to the model. The experimental results conducted on bayonet surveillance videos showed that the proposed method outperforms LBF, ERT and SDM, concerning with mean errors of the regression results.

articleTitle: Aging Related White Matter Tracts Detection Based on 42 Clinically Healthy Subjects
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) offers an efficient evaluation over microstructure of white matter integrity. In this study, we aim to study the white matter tracts, which are associated with normal ageing. 42 healthy subjects were included, which is composed of two groups. One is young subjects (age = 22.29±1.35), and the other is elder (age = 63.71±2.00). Statistical analysis over FA was carried out by TBSS. We observed FA decreases significantly in several white matter tracts, including anterior thalamic radiation (ATR), cingulum (cingulate gyrus), corticospinal tract (CST), forceps minor, forceps major, inferior longitudinal fasciculus (ILF), superior longitudinal fasciculus (SLF). Most found all tracts were reported in past literatures. Nevertheless, we are the first to find the relationship between forceps major and ageing.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Multi-pattern Retrieval Scheme of Regional PACS System Based Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to make the massive medical image resources from different devices and corresponding to different human tissues and organs and many kinds of diseases in the Picture Archiving and Communication System accurately and quickly retrieved and located in auxiliary clinical diagnosis, remote medical treatment and other applications, this paper designs a multi-pattern retrieval scheme of medical images based on regional PACS system and analyzes semantic annotation, visual feature library construction and other key technologies involved in achieving multi-pattern retrieval.

articleTitle: Research on the SPOC Literature Information Resources of Jianghan University Library
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The extensive practice of SPOC in higher education field has exerted great influence on the academic libraries. Starting from the angle of investigating the user habits of Jianghan University Library, through the comparative analysis of digital document information resources and the needs of SPOC teaching, the paper points out that: users are more inclined to use library resources to carry out independent study, the library can provide preferable resource assurance for the SPOC receivers, but the functions of platform still need to be soon improved, based on the existing resource structure, to improve resource construction according to demands of users is the feasible way for academic libraries to participate in the SPOC.

articleTitle: A Survey for Information Technology Based Roll Call Methods in University Education
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Roll call is an important tool to keep the student presence in the university classroom, its a assistant way to improve the teaching quality though it is usually not welcome by the students and professors. This paper survey the existing popular roll call methods, especially for those that based on Information Technology (IT), and according information based technology is described. We also present a very simple, efficient and practical roll call method, "Excel based roll call", for teachers of different major background, what the teacher need to do is just preparing a certain format Excel table and using it on a right way, no other complex hardware, software and database required, the roll call speed can reach twice students one second and the professor can say nothing during the roll call, the roll call method is from our past 10 year teaching experience and is welcome by our students, the education quality and the student-teacher relation can be enhanced, and we hope more professors can share our experience.

articleTitle: An Automatic Method to Extract Brain Tissue in CT Data
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, an automatic method is proposed to extract brain tissue in CT brain. Firstly, we use the adaptive threshold algorithm to compute the range of gray value of the brain tissue. Secondly, we use the range of the thresholds to estimate the position of seed point which is defined as the center of gravity of the brain. Finally, we propose a 3D region growing algorithm based on the pre-judgment to extract the brain tissue. The experiments show that the proposed method can extract the brain tissue in CT data automatically and efficiently.

articleTitle: Some New Statistics on Determine Network Models
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to make it easier to study the scale-free nature of the complex network, and to explore the topological structures of networks by mathematical methods. There are many successful mathematical methods shown in scale-free networks that are forming branches of mathematics and network science. We are motivated from the cumulative degree distribution and edge cumulative degree distribution of scale-free networks, re-designed several new methods of cumulative distribution to depict the networks. In this paper, two known networks as an example to illustrate, and prove the equivalence of several new formula, provides more methods for future research.

articleTitle: An Improved Denoising Algorithm of Feather and Down Image Based on KSVD
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, as a new signal representation, more and more sparse representation to the general concern, and signal processing and analysis had a very significant impact. All along, the hot issue is also a feather identification study, noise processing is an important feather duvets species identification problem has always been an important issue. This paper studies the sparse representation in image processing, while down on the species detection key technology research, the dictionary will be an improved KSVD down denoising algorithm, algorithm expressed by feather image sparse quality has improved, thereby improving the recognition rate down image. Practice shows that, based on KSVD down compared to the previous image denoising algorithm down effect is obvious improvement.

articleTitle: Research on Diagnosis Technology of Advanced Metering Infrastructure On-Site
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: According to the design scheme of different data acquire terminal, this paper studied Advanced metering infrastructure on-site diagnosis method used for construction of smart grid, and presents the second pulse incremental statistical expanding algorithm based on the pulse input unit and a precision timing source, developed a site diagnosis system of portable mobile, and developed automatic test software used in the test system. The system can provide controllable on-site environment parameters according to the test plan, change the input to the on-site data acquire terminal, analysis the communication content and output. The test results show that the test system can accurately measure the working parameters of data acquire terminal, meet the system design requirements.

articleTitle: Screening and Identification of Conjugated Linoleic Acid-producing Lactobacillus plantarum
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: A strain of Lactobacillus S21.1 was screened to produce conjugated linoleic acid from traditional northeastern fermented sauerkraut juice. Fermentation was performed by adding linoleic acid (0.4 mg/mL) into the culture medium, and the culture medium was fermented for 24 h at 37°C. Then, UV spectrophotometry was used to measure the linoleic acid content, which was measured as 10.082 μg/mL. Strain morphological characteristics observation, physiological-biochemical characteristic analysis, and 16SrDNA molecular biology identification were conducted to identify the strain S21.1 as Lactobacillus plantarum.

articleTitle: Improved Feature Selection Algorithm Based on Maximal Nearest-Neighbor Rough Approximation
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The feature selection algorithm based on maximal nearest neighbor rough approximation can not only deal with the mixed data, but also avoid the choice of the parameter values in the feature selection algorithm based on neighborhood rough sets. And it reduces the judgement of the sample. But the evaluation standard of this method only considers the importance of a single attribute which is relative to the result of the decision while calculating the importance of the attribute. It ignores the influence of the interaction between the attributes on the result of decision. So this paper sets up the new evaluation standard which is considered the influence of the attributes, and a forward greedy feature selection algorithm is constructed. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm can not only select fewer features, but also improve the accuracy of the classification.

articleTitle: Study on the Construction of Wisdom Campus Based on University Resource Planning (URP)
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the help of enterprise resource planning (ERP),this paper puts forward university resource planning (URP). It illustrates the related concepts, features, and core technologies of wisdom campus. Aiming at some problems during constructing wisdom campus, and through effectively planning the university information resources by URP, it constructs the wisdom campus model based on URP. This model can provide reference for "wisdom campus" and promote the development of educational information.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Statistics in the Research on the Relationship between Professional Commitment and Learning Efficacy of Preschool Education Students
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Professional commitment is the positive attitude and behavior of college students to identify their own majors, and pay the corresponding efforts happily. The purpose of this study was to investigate the status of professional commitment and learning efficacy of preschool education undergraduates, and the relationship between them. Method: Taking the method of cluster sampling, 210 undergraduates were selected, the analysis of variance, correlation analysis and regression analysis were used to analyze the survey data. Results show that the overall level of students' professional commitment was not very high, and that the overall learning efficacy of students was in the middle, the result also suggested that professional commitment and learning efficacy were significantly positively correlated, emotional commitment and ideal commitment were predictive variables of learning self-efficacy.

articleTitle: Mobile Leaning Knowledge Architecture Construction and Resource Integration in Information Management and Information System
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As a novel learning method, mobile learning will definitely become one of the most important part of learning based society. In this paper, we firstly analyze the disadvantage of the traditional in-class teaching pattern, aiming at Information Management System to research the mobile learning based knowledge architecture construction and related resource integration. According to the current curriculum architecture, we systematically review all of the subjective courses and relative knowledge modules, which contributes in organizing whole relationship among all of the modules, constructing the connections and improving the whole knowledge architecture. Our proposed plan would be beneficial in solving the problem existing in traditional in-class teaching pattern.

articleTitle: Differences in the Nasal Respiratory Function after the Treatment of Maxillary Cyst
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective:To observe the nasal resistance after medical combination treatments of maxillary cyst. Methods: 12 patients with maxillary cyst were selected, all cases were confirmed by sinus CT or MRI examination,disinfect both cheek`s skin and oral vestibular mucosa. Operation should be taken under topical anesthesia or surface anesthesia,check the cases` nasal passages with transanal endoscopic microsurgery,withdraw the cyst fluid with a injector form the top flank of the nose.Then inject the drug of maxillary cyst(which mainly contains iodine and hexadecadro solution )with a proportion of 2:1(i.e., take out 2 ml cyst fluid, inject of 1 ml drugs, and so on).Cyst if can not be normally punctured can undertake the surgery with the assistance of image recorder.We should check the patients` nasal airway resistance (NAR), nasal volumes(NV), and minimalcross. sectional area(MCA) using Eccovision Acoustic Rhinometer (HoodLabs, USA) and Anterior Rhinometer both before and after the treatments.Then deal the data with a computer. Results: 12 patients with maxillary sinus cyst came back to the hospital for a check of sinus CT check after treatment,compared with the data before the treatment,there are visible differences in general R(cmH20/LMi),general NV(cc) and MCA(cm2). (p<;0.05). Conclusion: Medical combination treatments of maxillary cyst is quiet a effective method to the treatment of maxillary cyst,in the mean time it can decrease the nasal resistance caused by maxillary cyst.

articleTitle: CloudPss-An Energy Internet Modeling and Simulation Tool in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Energy internet is studied as a promising electricity-centered energy network, which revolves around reliable framework, widely interconnected, highly intelligent and open interaction. In this paper, we introduce a software tool named CloudPss. It bases on cloud computing, and focuses on solving the problem of modeling and simulation of the energy internet. Compared with other modeling and simulation tools, CloudPss is much more flexible and efficient.

articleTitle: Smart Analysis Oriented Design of Health Statistics Data Model
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research Purpose: design a new data model to effectively analyze publicly opened health statistics data with fixed table structure. Proposed Methods: this paper established a data model based on star model, and used text similarity calculation method to identify the dimensions and correlations of indicators. Results: every table in the yearbook was split as per its properties and by indicator, time, geographic region and dimension, to form a star schema centered on "Yearbook data table", and through text similarity calculation method, the created "indicator table" and "dimension table" were utilized to determine the dimension of an indicator via custom macro program to find out its corresponding upper level indicators. Conclusion: the data model designed can effectively support the intelligent analysis of health statistic data and build foundation for health statistical data analysis systems.

articleTitle: The Application of Information Technology in Neurobiology Education
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The development of the internet makes education internationalization possible for a certain course. Massive open online courses (MOOCs) are proposed as the new teaching and learning style to meet challenges from higher medical education. 98 undergraduates (ages between 18 and 23, average 22±1.5) studying neurobiology in our college during 2015 and 2016 were selected, and randomly divided into 2 groups, MOOC group and control group. The results display MOOC group received higher theoretical and experimental scores than control group (p<;0.001). The questionnaire exhibits higher satisfaction assessment, improvment of understanding, motivation of study, ability of problem solving, enhancement of memory and classroom communication in MOOC group (P<;0.05). Our data show the application of MOOC-assisted teaching in neurobiology can improve the teaching efficacy, which is worthy of application and dissemination.

articleTitle: Model Checking PV Energy System with Remote Reprogramming Function
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the energy problems becoming serious, photovoltaic (PV) energy system attracts more and more attention. With the need of flexible control, the reliability of performance of the systems becomes more significant. In this paper, two models of the system with reprogramming function have been proposed. However, how to verify the reliability of the designed systems is a challenge. Thus this paper presents the probabilistic model checking technique with the tool of PRISM for the verification. The experimental results are expected to suggest the further improvements on distributed energy system construction.

articleTitle: Ontology Reduction Based on Axiomatic Cognitive Model for Ontology Learning
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Although it is easier to acquire knowledge from structured or unstructured data with NLP (Nature Language Processing) and Machine Learning techniques, it is still difficult to exclude logic errors using reinforcement learning on ontology construction. Ontology reduction is a key step when a learner agent removes the knowledge from the existing ontology in the process ontology learning. This proposal designs and validates the method of ontology reduction based on the axiomatic cognitive model, which include the ontology reduction postulates, axioms and operations of the learning construction. It is proved these operators subject to the established axiom system.ng model. Our approach aims at improving the efficiency and accuracy of the ontology.

articleTitle: Comparison of Several Common Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Knowledge-Based Method under Nonlinear Small Sample Conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article compared several knowledge-based fault diagnosis methods which common used last ten years under nonlinear small sample condition. The main content focused on accuracy, speed, generalization and implementation. The comparison result of these methods showed the parameter optimizated surpport vector machines have higher efficiency and broad prospect.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Application of CBL Teaching Method in the Teaching of the Kidney Disease in Internal Medicine Traditional of TCM
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to explore the effectiveness of case-based learning (CBL) as a teaching method, which was applied in the teaching of the kidney diseases in internal medicine of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM).The method was as follows :There were sixty undergraduates selected as the CBL experimental group in Soochow University, and the CBL was adopted to the study of the kidney disease of traditional Chinese medicine. At the same time the Lecture Based Learning (LBL) method was applied in another class, which was took as the control group. At the end of this semester, using the way of questionnaires and score statistics of theoretical knowledge, we evaluated the teaching effect which based on a qualitative approach and the analysis of the medical record. The content of the questionnaire involves whether or not to stimulate the learning interest, the enthusiasm of study, the ability of self-study, the comprehensive analysis ability, the ability of independent thinking, and promote the interaction relation between teachers and students. The result showed that there was significant difference between the CBL group and the LBL group on the basis of theoretical examination results (P<;0.01), meanwhiles there were also significant differences between the CBL group and the LBL group in the comprehensive medical record analysis (P<;0.01). The group of CBL's students had more learning interest and learning enthusiasm than LBL. We also saw the similarly results which included improving their ability to analyze and solve problems. Evidence shows that the way of CBL exhibit superior professional skills and effective learning compared with those instructed using traditional approaches.

articleTitle: Technique Improvement and Experience Sharing of Cannulation of the Mouse Submandibular Salivary Gland via the Wharton's Duct
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Patients with severe salivary gland dysfunction is common due to Sjogrens syndrome or radiotherapy because of head and neck cancer. These patients often have dry mouth, taste loss, severe tooth decay, pain, inflammation of the oral mucosa. Nowadays, as the biological sciences development, a variety of new treatments continue to emerge. Wherein the gene therapy has become a research hotspot. This Technique provides a convenient method for animal experiments and clinical gene therapy. Using viral vectors transfecting submandibular-salivary gland to expresse hEPOS, hGH, etc[1] provide a broader space for this technique. Positive preclinical gene therapy results have been shown in models of salivary gland diseases such as Sjögrens Syndrome and in acquired conditions such as xerostomia secondary to ionizing radiation of the head and neck. In the overall context of increasing evidence from human clinical trials that gene therapy is safe and effective, including a first-in-man trial involving salivary gland gene transfer (ClinicalTrials.gov number NCT00372320), therapeutic gene transfer to the human salivary gland appears to be close to becoming a practicable reality. I have engaged in this field for nearly a year and have made some technology improvements. Here I want to share my experience.

Index Terms: Head And Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

articleTitle: Construction of a System of Experiment Assessment of Medical Laboratory Technologies
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Changes of medical models have given rise to new development of demands of society and patients for medical services, they have also raised new requirements for test teaching positioning and teaching contents. The original experimental assessment criteria no longer apply to medical testing talent cultivation in the modern society. In order to meet the needs for medical laboratory technology development and medical testing personnel in the new era, explorations should be made to develop a set of experimental assessment system close to practices and systematic specifications. The assessment system should focus on experimental procedures and experimental details, increase research and innovation experiments, fully embody combinations of knowledge acquisition, ability building and quality education, emphasize students' creative thinking and innovation ability, foster teamwork awareness and rigorous work attitudes, make use of the guiding role of the assessment system to facilitate teaching reforms, and overall improve the teaching quality of medical laboratory technologies.

articleTitle: Supreme (TM) Largeal Mask Airway Size Choice in Anesthesthetic Practice for Chinese Adult Patients
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To explore the proper size of Supreme™ largeal mask airway in anesthetic practice for Chinese adult patients, 4804 females and 2089 males (age 18-80 years, American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status I&II) were enrolled in the study. We chose size 4 SLMA for males and size 3 SLMA for females regardless of body weight. Both of the females (with SLMA size 3) and males (with SLMA size 4) have a high successful rate of inserting the SLMA after general anesthesia. The SLMA size 3 had a significantly lower incidence of mucosal injury than the SLMA size 4 (P0.05). In conclusion, regardless of body weight, Supreme LMA size 3 is better for females and size 4 is better for male with higher inserting successful rate and fewer complications.

articleTitle: Mooc: A New Mode of Integrating and Sharing Knowledge Resources in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Massive open online course (MOOC) exposes the challenge and subversion to the traditional mode of education, and its way of sharing information and knowledge brings a new revelation to integrating and sharing of knowledge resources in colleges and universities. This paper presents an integration and knowledge sharing mode based on the mixed mode of xMOOC and cMOOC which is compatible to knowledge dissemination and social academy. The purpose of displaying the curriculum integration in knowledge system of information of the university is to accelerate the pace to integrate and share the knowledge resources, promote the coordination and innovation of knowledge, propel the professional interaction and compound talents training. Thus, universities are able ttoo enhance the external radiation of culture, science and technology.

articleTitle: Effect of JiangTangFangLong Prescription on Hs-CRP, ABI in Patients with Different Syndrome Types of Diabetes Deafness
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To study effect of JiangTangFangLong prescription on Serum hypersensitive c-reactive protein(hsCRP), Ankle arm index(ABI) in patients with different syndrome types of diabetes deafness. Method: The change of hs-CRP and ABI was tested before and after treatment in 42 cases (84 ears) of different syndrome types of diabetes deafness treated with JiangTangFangLong prescription. Compared with 40 normal people. Result: Different syndrome patients before treatment compared with normal, hs-CRP increased significantly (P<;0.05) and ABI reduced (P<;0.05). Different syndrome patients after treatment compared with normal, hsCRP of Yin scorching type has increased and ABI has fallen, but no significant statistical significance (P>0.05). Gas Yin deficiency and Yin and Yang deficiency compared with nomal person and before and after treatment have statistical significance. Hs-CRP has increased and ABI has fallen(P<;0.05). Gas Yin deficiency and Yin and Yang deficiency compared with Yin scorching type, have statistical significance. Conclusion: JiangTangFangLong prescription can improve the level of hs-CRP and ABI of different syndrome types of diabetes deafness to different extent, and provide objective basis for prevention and control of diabetes.

articleTitle: Cultivation of Students’ Learning Strategies in Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the information age, using network to study has become a new trend for obtaining knowledge and cultivating the capacity of human being. The learning strategy in network environment is a brand new strategy, representing the future way of thinking and living, even the way of surviving for human being. It determines the learning efficiency and success of learners. Article mainly states how to cultivate students' network learning strategy from three aspects, namely, study meaning of network learning strategy, connotation and features of network learning environment, and training methods of network learning strategy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of College Science and Technology Innovation Contest Management System Based on NET Platform
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: College science and technology innovation contest is an important carrier of training practical talents in college which can help with the training of college students' comprehensive quality and innovation capacity. To strength the management of competition works and makes sure the college science and technology innovation contest work out smoothly, we need to develop college contest based on NET. Firstly, this paper carried a systematic needs analysis and system function design, and specifically on system implementation technology, major functional modules, reporting and data export design and implementation. Ensure the achievement of the management to be network and automation and improve the efficiency of Science and Technology Innovation contest in Jiangxi Province.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of a Wizard-Based Outpatient EMR in Oral and Maxilla Facial Surgery Department From the Aspects of Documentation Time and Record Quality — A Randomized, Cross-over Study
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Background: The electronic medical records(EMR) have been widely used in healthcare organizations all around the world, which is supposed having the potential to improve the efficiency in outpatient clinics. But the results about the function of EMR were controversial. We developed a Wizard-based outpatient EMR(WEMR) system dedicated to oral and maxillofacial surgery outpatient. Objective: To compare the efficiency of the Wizard-based outpatient EMR(WEMR) and the traditional keyboard character input outpatient EMR(TEMR), which was commonly used in oral and maxillofacial surgery outpatient. Methods: A well trained nurse, who was diagnosed with impacted lower third molar, acted as a standardized patient. 7 attending doctors and 21 interns were randomly allocated into two groups for EMR writing, one group writing medical records with TEMR, and the other with WEMR. And after 3 months of washout period, the writing tools were exchanged. A medical record scoring scale was produced for this standardized patient by three specialists. The documentary time and medical record quality scores of TEMR and WEMR were compared and analyzed. Results: The results showed that the documentary time decreased while the record quality score increased in WEMR group compared with TEMR group, and there were statistically difference between the two groups. At the same time, in the terms of record quality score comparison, the increase in interns group appeared to be greater than attending doctors group after using WEMR. Conclusions: The WEMR system can significantly reduce the documentary time and improve quality of medical records in outpatient of oral and maxillofacial surgery department. At the same time, the WEMR system can help the interns to master medical record writing skills.

articleTitle: Factor Analysis of Medical Expenses of the Hepatitis a Patients in Guangdong
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Nine influence factors for medical expenses of hepatitis A were measured on 115 patients with this disease. Next, factor analysis was performed to identify underlying variables, or factors, that explain the pattern of correlations within a set of observed risk factors. The factor analysis disclosed four factors that explained more than 76% of the variance: drug and examination costs factor, therapeutic and nursing care costs, surgery and medical material costs and diagnostic costs. Also, results of the present study do encourage efforts to explore new methods designated to find more effective way to control medical expense.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Experiment for Intelligent Single-Slit Diffraction
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: By applying Single Chip Processor (SCP) technology, we improve the traditional single-slit diffraction experiment. Both the sampling of experiment data and the output of experiment results can be automatically carried out. The improvement of the experiment is to control motor rotation by Single-Chip-Processor STC89C52, to drive light intensity detection chip moving, and to transfer the data to computer by serial port and achieve the diffraction fringe intensity of real-time display. Compared with the original experiment, the light intensity distribution of single slit diffraction pattern is not only visible, but also the error caused by the manual operation is reduced, which makes the calculation result more accurate and convenient.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mobile Terminal Voice Communication System
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Voice interaction is an important way of human-computer interaction, voice communication in various mobile applications more and more attention. According to the characteristics of the Android system, research on the voice communication, gives a concrete implementation plan, which is based on iLBC code, calls to the underlying libraries through JNI technology, with multithreading and caching mechanism that enables voice communication. Practice shows that it has good performance and user experience.

articleTitle: The Influence of Panax Notoginseng Saponins and Tripterygium Glycosides on the TNF-1, IL-6, PAI-1 Level in CIA Rat Peripheral Blood and the MCP-1 Expression in Myocardium
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To observe the influence of Panax Notoginseng Saponins and tripterygium glycosides on the TNF-α, IL-6, PAI-1 level in CIA rat peripheral blood and the MCP-1 expression in myocardium. Methods: randomly dividing the successfully copied CIA rats into model, TG(10mg/Kg.d), PNS(200mg/Kg.d)+TG(10mg/Kg.d), MTX(1.6mg/Kg.w) group and Control group was set. Drawing blood after a six-week administration, opening the chest to take out the heart. The liquid phase protein chip technology was used to detect the content of serum TNF-α, IL-6, PAI-1, and immunohistochemical method to detect the myocardial MCP-1 protein expression. Results: Compared with the control group, the rat serum TNF-α, IL-6, PAI-1 level in CIA model group is obviously increased, the myocardial MCP-1 protein expression is significantly up-regulated, TG and PNS can obviously reduce the TNF-α, IL-6, PAI-1 level in serum, improve the pathological state of myocardium, and down-regulate the expression of MCP-1 in myocardium, and its effect is significantly better than that of TG and MTX group. Conclusions: the effective components of Chinese herbal medicine TG combined with PNS has a significant role in the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular injury, its mechanism may be related to reducing serum TNF-α, IL-6, PAI-1 and MCP-1 expression in myocardium to exert anti-inflammatory effect.

articleTitle: Predictors for Clinical Pregnancy in First ART Cycles in Western China
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Aim To identify risk factors and predict the success rate of a clinical pregnancy. Methods A retrospective case-control study including 1748 couples with first cycles assisted reproductive technology (ART) of infertile patients in Reproductive Medicine Center of Tangdu hospital from Jan. 2007 through Jan 2010. 46 risk factors (clinical or experimental) associated with clinical pregnancy outcome were chosen to for statistical analysis. Multiple logistic regression analysis was used to identify risk factors and evaluate the predictors of success rate of a clinical pregnancy. Results The multivariate analysis identified female age, endometrial thickness, stimulation protocol and semen density before treatments were independent factors associated with clinical pregnancy rate. The area under the ROC curve for a clinical pregnancy was 0.78. The positive and negative predictive values were 0.73 and 0.42, respectively. Conclusion Younger female age, proper endometrial thickness and high semen density before treatments were associated with clinical pregnancy. These findings may assist physicians in predicting the probability the clinical pregnancy in first ART cycle.

articleTitle: Prospects of Applying Pervasive Computing to the Construction of Network Interactive Modality in Foreign Language Classroom Discourse
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Currently, fast advancement of digital electronic communication technology enables learning being underway in a virtual and multimodal form. This study, through qualitative analysis of the tendency of virtual learning community, the potential of pervasive computing technology as well as the modality research in classroom context, discussed the prospects of applying pervasive computing technology to the construction of network interactive modality in foreign language teaching within the theoretical framework of Systemic Functional Linguistics. It was revealed that network interactive modality is the best choice for current interactive teaching and learning as it can optimize the interpersonal function of classroom discourse. It is promising and significant to apply pervasive computing technology to establish virtual "real context" in foreign language class.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Intelligent Medical Information System Based on the Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research Purpose: Design a mobile intelligent medical information system based on the Internet of things technology. Proposed Methods: First, sort out the basic theory and research status through the literature research, including the Internet of things technology, mobile medical systems and smart hospitals. Then conduct on-site research through field visits, questionnaires, opinion evaluation and other methods, including hospital diagnosis and treatment process, charging process, hospital process and the function of hospital information system. Finally, according to the survey results, use the method of software engineering to complete system requirement analysis and system design. Results: Based on the mobile phone near field wireless communication technology and indoor navigation technology, complete the various business processes carding, functional design, interface design and software and hardware environment support analysis. Conclusion: The mobile intelligent medical information system based on the Internet of things technology can greatly reduce the patient's treatment time, improve the patient's treatment efficiency and hospital management efficiency, and can further regulate and promote the development of intelligent medical treatment.

articleTitle: Automated Quantitative Image Analysis of Hematoxylin-Eosin Staining Slides in Lymphoma Based on Hierarchical Kmeans Clustering
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The microscopic image of tissue section stained by hematoxylin-eosin (HE) is an essential part in histopathology researches. Automated HE image processing remains challenging because forms and distributions of cells and other tissue structures are always extremely irregular with no clear boundaries, especially in conducting high throughput analysis which demands higher accuracy and efficient quantification for the reference of pathologists. To solve this problem, we proposed an automated quantitative image analysis pipeline based on hierarchical clustering of local correlations, which segmented the image into nuclei, cytoplasm and extracellular spaces by classifying image pixels on the basis of local correlation features. Segmentation for precise nucleus boundaries was then performed, and finally a set of indicators characterizing tissue structures were extracted to complete quantification of HE images. Experimental results showed high accuracy and adaptability in cell segmentation despite data variance. Quantitative indicators obtained in this essay provide a reliable evidence for the analysis of HE staining lymphoma pathological image.

articleTitle: The Diagnostic Model of Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The paper described a rapid decision support model for neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (NRDS), which was suitable for extensive neonatal related diseases for diagnose and identification rapidly. The available data, collected in No.307 hospital of PLA, was provided to several intelligent algorithms(artificial neural networks, random forests, support vector machines) to create a model for predicting the NRDS probability for newborns. It showed that prediction accuracy of the model for NRDS could reach up to 98.07% in test. We observed that predictions of the model are in agreement with the literature, demonstrating that model might be an important tool for supporting decision making in medical practice. Other feature of this method were the input parameters could be obtained easily in clinic and the implementation of the risk assessment could provide rapid decision support information for clinic.

articleTitle: The Features of Lymph Node Metastasis of Differentiated Thyroid Carcinoma and the Choice of Lateral Neck Lymph Nodes Dissection
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: The clinicopathologic features of central area and lateral neck lymph nodes metastasis were retrospectively analyzed in order to better understand the characteristics of cervical lymph node metastasis, and provide an objective reasonable choice basis of surgical treatment cervical lymph node for the surgeons. Methods: All patients from January 2008 to July 2010 in our hospital were collected, 329 cases of resection of thyroid cancer and central lymph node dissection treatment of PTC were analyzed (Including 115 cases of lateral neck lymph nodes dissection at the same time). We then analyzed the correlation between the clinicopathological features of central lymph nodes and lateral lymph node metastasis. Results: The average age of 329 cases of patients was 43 years, male 66 cases, female 263 cases, tumor diameter average 1.11cm, the average number of tumors 1.76, 97 cases of bilateral, 232 cases of unilateral, 44.07% of central lymph node metastasis in 329, 57.39% of lateral lymph node metastasis in 115 cases of lateral neck lymph nodes dissection, 35.11% of central lymph node metastasis in 262 cases of patients with a clinical negative result of central lymph nodes preoperative examination, 28.81% of lateral lymph node metastasis in 59 cases of patients with a negative result of lateral lymph nodes preoperative examination. (1) Papillary thyroid carcinoma those who were in the groups of male, >45 years old, associated with extrathyroidal invasion, the diameter >1cm, absence of other thyroid diseases, absence of nodular goiter had a higher rate of central lymph node metastasis (P=0.028, 0.003, 0.001, 0.000, 0.000, 0.001, respectively). And the group that Ultrasonography examination showed a positive result of central lymph nodes had a higher rate of central lymph node metastasis than the group that Ultrasonography showed a negative result (P=0.000). (2) Papillary thyroid carcinoma those who were in the groups of male, >45 years old, unilateral tumor had a higher rate of lateral lymph node metastasis (P=0.040, 0.008, 0.021, 0.000). And the group of central lymph node metastasis positive had a higher rate of lateral lymph node metastasis than the group of central lymph node metastasis negative (P=0.000). (3) Those clinically examination negative central lymph nodes metastasis papillary thyroid carcinoma who were in the groups of the diameter > 1cm, absence of other thyroid diseases, absence of nodular goiter had a higher rate of central lymph node metastasis(P=0.018, 0.001, 0.004). (4) Those cases with a negative result of lateral cervical lymph nodes examination whom in the group of central lymph node metastasis had a higher rate of lateral lymph node metastasis than the group of absence of central lymph node metastasis(P=0.027). Conclusions: There were certain associations between the central lymph nodes metastasis, lateral lymph node metastasis and clinicopathological features in thyroid papillary carcinoma patients. This is of important significance for clinical treatment choice.

articleTitle: Influence of Traditional Chinese Medicine Five-Element Musical Therapy on Depression Severity and Neurological Functional Deficit Scale in Patients with Post-Stroke Depression
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To observe the influence of Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) five-element musical therapy on depression severity and neurological functional deficit scale in patients with post-stroke depression (PSD), so as to evaluate the therapeutic efficacy of this method, observe the adverse reactions and evaluate its safety. Methods: A total of 92 patients with PSD were randomly divided into control group (n = 32), treatment group A (n= 30) and treatment group B (n=30). All groups were given basic therapies for cerebral infarction, on which basis control group was added with oral Sertraline Hydrochloride Tablets, while treatment group A with needling Baihui plus acupoint injection on Yanglingquan. On the basis of treatment group A, treatment group B was added with five-element musical therapy. Hamilton's depression scale (HAMD)-17 and neorological functional deficit symptom severity score (1995) (SSS for short) before and after treatment were observed and efficaccy was evaluaed in all groups. Treatment Emergent Symptom Scale (TESS) was compared and safety was evaluated. Results: HAMD score decreased to some extent in all groups, which was markedly higher in treatment group B than that in treatment group A, and there was significant difference (P<;0.01). Comparison of neurological funtional deficit SSS showed that treatment group B was markedly higher than treatment group A and control group in SSS score, and there were significat differences (P<;0.01). Comparison of TESS among 3 groups indicated that TESS score was the highest in control group, but the lowest in treatment group B, and the differences among 3 groups were significant (P<;0.01). Conclusion: Needling, acupoint injection combined with five-element musical therapy based on principle of "treatment of both body and mind" can effectively improve the depression severity and neurological functional deficit severity of patients with PSD, which is less in adverse reactions than western medicines and is more likely to be accepted by patients, thus deserving to be popularized in clinic.

publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study aimed to employ the recently developed fuzzy measure entropy (FuzzyMEn) method to compare the difference in heart rate variability (HRV) between rest and exercise states in hypoxic environment. Four healthy male volunteers were enrolled in this study. For each subject, electrocardiography (ECG) and finger pulse were recorded in ten days to obtain the heart rate (HR) time series. articleTitle: Four-Nucleotide and Six-Nucleotide Abortive Transcripts Can Inhibit Transcription
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Abortive transcripts (ATs) are 2-nucleotide (nt) to 15-nt nascent RNAs that are synthesized and released by RNA polymerase during the transcription initiation period, a phenomenon known as abortive initiation (AI). Abortive initiation occurs in vitro with all characterized RNA polymerase, including bacterial, archaeal, eukaryotic, and bacteriophag. However, the roles of ATs currently remain unknown. In this study, it was found that the 4-nt and 6-nt ATs were produced from a specific gene which could inhibit the transcription of their own gene and of other genes in Escherichia coli. 4-nt ATs displayed the similar abilities to interfere with the transcription of same genes, while different 6-nt ATs showed the varied abilities to interfere with the transcription of same genes. Furthermore, there was no relation between the transcriptional inhibition level and the number of identical sequence sites. The effect of the single-strand DNAs on transcription differed from that of the abortive transcripts. Thus, our finding indicates that AI may be a novel transcriptional regulation mechanism that can prevent excessive transcription and compete for resources for gene expression during the initial transcription period, the transcriptional inhibition mechanism of ATs is most likely not associated with complementary base pairing.

articleTitle: Investigation and Analysis of Informatization Development Status of 1283 Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to investigate the basic situation of the TCM hospital information organization and management, capital investment, information system construction and application, and informatization performance development, to analyze the main problems, we carry out sampling and the corresponding survey according to the principle of provinces, cities and countries. And then, the basic situation of 1283 Chinese medicine hospital informatization is analyzed, and relevant suggestions are put forward on this basis. The following related recommendations are used to improve the information construction of the TCM hospitals. The awareness of information construction of leadership in hospitals should be strengthened, the talents of information technology should be trained and introduced. The allocation of funds should be optimized, and the emphasis on Data analysis and standardization construction should be strengthened.

articleTitle: Variation Features of Soil Physical Property of Different Forest Land Types in Southern Slope of Qilian Mountain
publicationTitle: 2016 8th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The research material in this article is the four forest lands in the southern slope of Qilian Mountain, they are the forest of Picea crassifolia, Sabina przewalskii and the Potentilla fruticosa shrubwood, Caragana jubata shrubwood, we discuss the influence of different forest land types to the soil physical property and the water conservation function. The research result shows that the soil water content and porosity of different types of forest lands present a decreasing trend along with the increase of soil depth. Different soil depth acts roughly as Picea crassifolia > Potentilla fruticosa > Sabina przewalskii, Caragana jubata changes between the three ones, on the whole, it would be Picea crassifolia > Potentilla fruticosa > Sabina przewalskii, the soil water content of Caragana jubata and Potentilla fruticosaare are almost the same.
